info.name: Kiteworks API Documentation activities sharedMailbox API

params.name: orderBy
params.description:
Sort order for the results.
Allowed values: `modified:asc`, `modified:desc`, `active:asc`, `active:desc`.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of items to skip before returning results, for pagination.

params.name: active
params.description: Filter by active status. If true, returns only active shared mailboxes; if false, returns only inactive ones.

params.name: id:in
params.description: Comma-separated list of shared mailbox user IDs to filter by.  (Recommended request size <= 100)

items.docs:
### Description:
  Returns a paginated list of shared mailboxes available to the current user.
### Precondition:
  The user must be authenticated and belong to an internal domain.
### Response:
  A list of shared mailboxes is returned.

info.name: Update current user's shared mailbox active status

items.docs:
### Description:
  Updates the active status of one or more shared mailboxes for the current user.
### Precondition:
  The user must be authenticated and belong to an internal domain.
### Response:
  The updated list of shared mailboxes is returned.

info.name: Return current user's shared mailbox counters

params.name: id:in
params.description: Comma-separated list of shared mailbox user IDs to filter by.  (Recommended request size <= 100)

items.docs:
### Description:
  Returns unread message counters for the current user's active shared mailboxes.
### Precondition:
  The user must be authenticated.
### Response:
  A list of mail counters for each active shared mailbox is returned.

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the user.

items.docs:
### Description:
  Returns the application settings for the specified shared mailbox.
### Precondition:
  The user must be authenticated and the specified shared mailbox must be active.
### Response:
  The shared mailbox settings are returned.

info.name: List web forms available to a shared mailbox

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the user.

params.name: returnEntity
params.description: If true, includes the entity in the response body.

params.name: with
params.description: Specifies additional fields to include in the response.

params.name: mode
params.description: Determines the detail level of the response body.

items.docs:
### Description:
  Returns a list of web forms available to the specified shared mailbox.
### Precondition:
  The user must be authenticated and the specified shared mailbox must be active.
### Response:
  A list of web forms is returned.

params.name: orderBy
params.description:
Sort order for the results.
`modified:asc` – Sort by last modified date, ascending.
`modified:desc` – Sort by last modified date, descending.
`active:asc` – Sort by active status, ascending.
`active:desc` – Sort by active status, descending.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results to skip before returning, for pagination.

params.name: active
params.description: Filter by active status. If true, returns only active shared mailboxes; if false, returns only inactive ones.

params.name: id:in
params.description: Comma-separated list of shared mailbox user UUIDs to filter by.  (Recommended request size <= 100)

items.docs:
### Description:
  Returns a paginated list of shared mailboxes, optionally filtered by user IDs.
### Precondition:
  Caller must have system, application, or helpdesk admin role.
### Response:
  A list of shared mailboxes is returned.

### Description:
  Converts the specified user account into a shared mailbox and assigns the specified members.
### Precondition:
  Caller must have system, application, or helpdesk admin role.
### Response:
  The shared mailbox is created and its details are returned.

params.name: id:in
params.description: Comma-separated list of shared mailbox user UUIDs to delete.  (Recommended request size <= 100)

items.docs:
### Description:
  Deletes the specified shared mailboxes and restores the associated user accounts.
### Precondition:
  Caller must have system, application, or helpdesk admin role.
### Response:
  The shared mailboxes are deleted successfully.

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the user.

### Description:
  Updates the member list of the specified shared mailbox.
### Precondition:
  Caller must have system, application, or helpdesk admin role.
### Response:
  The shared mailbox is updated and its details are returned.
